title: Z1 900 1972 Legend (Circuit Spec)
description: Representing Kawasaki's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Kawasaki Z1 900 1972 Legend (Circuit Spec) is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 900cc powerplant pumps out 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
